metric_units.feasibility: fraction of instances with at least one strictly feasible candidate
metric_units.conditional_gap: mean conditional gap-to-reference over instances with a feasible candidate; optimality-gap wording is reserved for certified references
metric_units.external_reported_gap: author-reported aggregate table value, retained verbatim as a fraction and not reinterpreted as sharing CLASP's denominator or certification semantics

new_iid_reference_contract.separation_rule: New-IID reference quality is established only by the frozen benchmark reference-solver contract and per-row native evidence; it is never inherited from an external paper's terminology or point estimate.

cvrp.certification_requirement: No optimality claim; freeze and audit the deterministic raw-Euclidean heuristic on every row.

jssp.certification_requirement: Every retained row must be native CP-SAT OPTIMAL with integral objective equal to best bound and strict schedule replay.

mis.certification_requirement: Every retained row must be native Gurobi OPTIMAL with integral incumbent equal to bound, zero reported gap, and strict independent-set replay.

op.certification_requirement: Every retained row must be native Gurobi OPTIMAL for the raw-Euclidean open-path model with integral incumbent equal to bound, zero reported gap, and strict route replay.

tsp.certification_requirement: No optimality claim; freeze and audit the deterministic raw-Euclidean heuristic on every row.

external_context.name: LLMCoSolver SFT+FOARL best-of-8
external_context.status: NeurIPS 2025 publication; aggregate Table 1 point estimates only
external_context.reason_not_claim_eligible: These values belong only to the released historical first-100 author protocol. The aggregator has no author-protocol replication receipt or paired outputs and must not apply them to a new IID benchmark.

cvrp.reason_not_claim_eligible: The paper describes CVRP supervision as near-optimal LKH-3 output, not a certified optimum; retain this only as an author-protocol gap-to-heuristic context.

jssp.reason_not_claim_eligible: The paper explicitly calls the OR-Tools CP-SAT reference near-optimal and imposes a 300-second limit; no per-row optimality certificates are supplied.

mis.reason_not_claim_eligible: The paper says MIS references are obtained by Gurobi, but provides no per-row native status, incumbent, bound, gap, or retained certificate.

op.reason_not_claim_eligible: The released OP serializer duplicates the depot, shifts prizes, omits a node, and uses rounded distance/budget semantics; its table denominator is not the raw-Euclidean CLASP OP protocol.

tsp.reason_not_claim_eligible: The paper calculates this value against task-solver output based on LKH rather than a retained certified optimum; retain it only as author-protocol gap-to-heuristic context.

repair_n8.postprocessing: grammar-constrained decoding plus task-specific deterministic repair

external_context.name: FALCON fixed-N=8
external_context.reason_not_claim_eligible: FALCON combines BOPO, grammar constraints, and task-specific repair under an unmatched preprint protocol. It is systems context, not a claim-authorizing target for CLASP repair outputs.

cvrp.reason_not_claim_eligible: Preprint aggregate against an author-protocol heuristic reference; no matched per-instance reproduction is available.

jssp.reason_not_claim_eligible: The inherited JSSP denominator is a time-limited near-optimal CP-SAT reference, not retained per-row certified optima.

mis.reason_not_claim_eligible: The inherited MIS denominator is described as Gurobi output without per-row native certificate evidence.

op.reason_not_claim_eligible: The inherited OP setup is not objective- and instance-equivalent to the raw-Euclidean CLASP OP protocol.

tsp.reason_not_claim_eligible: Preprint aggregate against an author-protocol heuristic reference; no matched per-instance reproduction is available.

repair_adaptive_n8_64.postprocessing: adaptive sampling plus grammar-constrained decoding and task-specific deterministic repair

external_context.name: FALCON adaptive N=8..64
external_context.reason_not_claim_eligible: FALCON adaptive inference uses a learned confidence stopping rule and an unmatched repair stack. CLASP has no frozen adaptive producer, so these values are context only.

cvrp.reason_not_claim_eligible: Preprint aggregate against an author-protocol heuristic reference under unmatched adaptive compute.

jssp.reason_not_claim_eligible: The inherited JSSP denominator is time-limited and near-optimal, and adaptive compute is unmatched.

mis.reason_not_claim_eligible: The inherited MIS denominator lacks per-row Gurobi certificates, and adaptive compute is unmatched.

op.reason_not_claim_eligible: The inherited OP setup is cross-protocol invalid for raw-Euclidean CLASP, and adaptive compute is unmatched.

tsp.reason_not_claim_eligible: Preprint aggregate against an author-protocol heuristic reference under unmatched adaptive compute.

context_only.name: ACCORD
context_only.reason_not_in_numeric_table: Different datasets, representation, task suite, model family, and inference budget; useful as a representation baseline, not a matched leaderboard row.
